examples.source: If qubits 1-3 are in the $|1\rangle$ state, and qubit 0 is initially in the $|0\rangle$ state, the first X gate will flip qubit 0 to $|1\rangle$ and all qubits will be in $|1\rangle$. This means the MCMT gate will apply an overall sign change or phase flip, as desired.
